meta.title: 6 habits of people with a genuinely high IQ

beats.text: Six habits that quietly give away a high IQ.
One. They question things most people accept without a second thought.
Two. They read far outside their own field — on purpose.
Three. They're comfortable saying three hard words: I don't know.
Four. They guard long, unbroken stretches of deep focus.
Five. They change their mind the moment the evidence does.
Six. They treat boredom as a signal to get curious, not to reach for a screen.
None of these is a gift you're born with. Every one is a habit you can start today.
